source_locator: R2226: ch. I (May seizure by 3rd Kure SNLF) and ch. II (7–8 August defense)
current_activity: defending Tulagi against the Marine landing
notes: Zimmerman, chapter I: the 3rd Kure SNLF had seized Tulagi and Gavutu on 4 May 1942. Chapter II and Miller, chapter III, describe the 7–8 August defense; almost the entire garrison was killed. Confidence 0.5 (one official family names the unit; Miller describes sailors and laborers on Tulagi without this designation). The May landing is earlier than OP-CAMP-GUADALCANAL and is not entered as a campaign claim.

source_locator: R2226: ch. II; R2225: ch. III, Tulagi occupied by 1500 on 8 August
current_activity: garrison destroyed in the defense of Tulagi
notes: Miller, chapter III: by 1500 on 8 August 1942 the occupation of Tulagi was complete; about 200 of the original garrison were killed, three surrendered, about forty escaped to Florida. Zimmerman, chapter II, agrees the garrison was essentially destroyed. Destroyed is recorded on this date. Confidence 0.5 (the designation is from Zimmerman, chapter I; Miller does not use the unit name in chapter III).
